summary: DressupAxisMap gains a Centre property (vector) that sets the rotation centre for the 3D path display, auto-fills Centre, Radius and AxisMap from the largest cylindrical face in the Job models/stock on creation, and the task panel's Reverse combo becomes an "Invert Direction" checkbox.

pages.reason: Path/Dressup/Gui/AxisMap.py: new App::PropertyVectorDistance 'Centre' (centre of rotation, replaces the implicit (0,0,-Radius) centre; migrated on restore); defineCylinder() sets Centre/Radius/AxisMap from the largest Part.Cylinder face in job.Model + Stock on creation (AxisMap -> 'X->B' when the cylinder axis is Y); AxisMapEdit.ui: 'Reverse' QComboBox replaced by QCheckBox 'Invert Direction', axis map combo now populated from the property enumeration
